scope: PROPOSED, SCOPE ONLY: SCOPE ONLY (not built by this request): a signed-receipt form for TVC. A TVC-emitted receipt (for example stegverse.tvc.labs-conformance-receipt/v1 from StegVerse-Labs/TVC#539, TVC_SKAP_CUSTODY_REFERENCE_ISSUE from TVC#537, TVC_NODE_LEDGER_OPENED_SIGNER_PUBLISH from TVC#540) gains a detached Ed25519 signature envelope over its canonical body under a declared domain, by a signer whose key is generated and held in TV/TVC custody only and whose public-key reference is published by a TV/TVC transition with a publication receipt. A consumer (LLM-adapter#432, the Labs ratchet's TVC conformance consumer) may then cite a TVC receipt ref in place of a separate signature. No key material in any repository; no new dependency; verification is E0 (standard library, pinned public key); non-authorizing.
